headline: On November 17, 1986: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 UFO sighting over Alaska
captionCards: Three UFOs seen on radar by FAA and Air Force
One of the most documented UFO sightings in aviation history
instagramCaption:
Japan Airlines Flight 1628 saw three objects near Alaska.

Captain Kenji Terauchi reported two small ships and a mothership. 
FAA and Air Force radar confirmed the objects. 
Some believe Jupiter and Mars were mistaken for UFOs.

It remains one of the most documented aviation UFO incidents.
